in_marathi.name: Jitandar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of Dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jitandar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jitandar is a Sanskrit name that signifies the victory of dharma or righteousness. The name is derived from the words 'jit' meaning victory and 'andar' meaning inner or within. It is a name that inspires bravery, strength, and a strong sense of justice. In Hindu mythology, Jitandar is the name of a king who ruled with wisdom and compassion.
